POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.

3. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

5. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers in Power Mechanics.

6. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

8. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

9. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.

10. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

11. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

12. When learning Surface Developmen t of prisms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Road Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Developmen t of prisms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Development of pyramids and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly drawing and Sectioning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
